typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystUnallocatedTradesLondonStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		entry_time as date,
		trade_date as string,
		settle_date as string,
		buy_sell as string,
		counterparty as string,
		isin as string,
		currency as string,
		total_cash as string,
		principal as string,
		current_par as string,
		price as string,
		salesperson as string,
		import_source as string,
		security_description as string,
		accrued_interest as string,
		cusip as string,
		captureDate as timestamp,
		legal_entity as string,
		product_type as string,
		inventory as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblCatalystTrade	source(output(
		entry_time as date,
		catalyst_trade_number as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
fromtblCatalystTrade derive({Copy of DESK_NAME} = DESK_NAME,
		{Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME} = TRADING_UNIT_NAME) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion select(mapColumn(
		{Copy of DESK_NAME} = {Copy of DESK_NAME},
		{Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME} = {Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME},
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_NAME = DESK_NAME
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> DataConversion0
DataConversion0,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(DataConversion0@entry_time == entry_time && DataConversion0@catalyst_trade_number == catalyst_trade_number,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		current_par as string,
		entry_time as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		total_cash as string,
		cusip as string,
		settle_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		security_description as string,
		inventory as string,
		trade_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		principal as string,
		salesperson as string,
		deskName as string,
		tradingUnitName as string,
		price as string,
		counterparty as string,
		currency as string,
		legal_entity as string,
		accrued_interest as string,
		buy_sell as string,
		import_source as string,
		isin as string,
		productType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		current_par,
		entry_time,
		total_cash,
		cusip,
		settle_date,
		security_description,
		inventory,
		trade_date,
		catalyst_trade_number,
		loadDate = captureDate,
		principal,
		salesperson,
		deskName = {Copy of DESK_NAME},
		tradingUnitName = {Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME},
		price,
		counterparty,
		currency,
		legal_entity,
		accrued_interest,
		buy_sell,
		import_source,
		isin,
		productType = product_type),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystUnallocatedTradesLondonStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystUnallocatedTradesLondonStaging
